Triangle and uniform-average claims follow by exact orbit counts and sums. Rates and clock normalization are explicit.

value.rationale: The condition of three walkers on a triangle probes a canonical local three-body geometry on a pair of cospectral strongly regular graphs. Exact pair meeting means and even the uniform triple mean coincide, so their nonzero triangle-conditioned mean gap isolates genuinely higher-order kinetic information. The small rational gap is meaningful as a minimal structural fingerprint, not as a claim of large practical effect or a trivial arbitrary table entry.
